---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the schema or documentation
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the solution you'd like** A clear and concise description of what you
want to happen.

**Motivation and use cases** Why is this feature important? Describe the use
cases and who benefits.

**Proposed schema changes (if any)** If this requires schema additions or
migrations, provide a sketch of the SQL changes or migration plan.

**Alternatives considered** List other approaches considered and why they were
not chosen.

**Additional context** Any other context or screenshots about the feature
request.
